name: @tn4consulting/shared-platform-standards
description: Multi-team coordination tooling for the mfe-pot family: a check-platform-versions CLI enforcing platform-versions.json against this repo's resolved dependency versions (no sibling clone of mfe-pot-platform required), a check-bff-boundaries CLI enforcing the BFF/UI call-boundary design principles, a sync-platform-standards CLI that copies a curated PLATFORM_STANDARDS.md into this repo's docs/ (so Claude Code's CLAUDE.md @import has something real to point at even in a standalone clone), and shared eslint/tsconfig/jest config fragments. Deliberately plain files with no build step -- same shape as @tn4consulting/shared-federation-config -- see README.md.
